registers.name: ID
registers.description: Speaker identity, not a separate capability or ABI register.

registers.name: COMMAND
registers.description: Full-strobe write1 starts valid stopped tone, write2 stops. Other values SLVERR; reads0.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Running bit0, reason[6:4]:0 normal/stop,2 heartbeat expiry,3 stop_n,4 duration expiry.

registers.name: HEARTBEAT_FRAMES
registers.description: Read advancing audio frame counter. Full-strobe write0x53504b31 refreshes500ms lease; other writes SLVERR.

registers.name: SAMPLE_RATE
registers.description: Fixed rounded nominal sample-rate constant, not measurement. Actual rate CLOCK_HZ/608.

registers.name: CLOCK
registers.description: Packaged audio clock parameter in Hz.

registers.name: FREQUENCY
registers.description: Tone20..12000Hz. DDS multiplier88936 assumes nominal29.361979MHz clock.

registers.name: LEVEL
registers.description: Linear digital amplitude0..100 percent, not ESP32 analog volume.

registers.name: LIMIT
registers.description: 100..30000ms session; heartbeat does not extend this bound.
